name: MonarchAiStarterPrompts
title: AiStarterPrompts
wrapsNative: LazyVGrid of Button with a custom ButtonStyle
summary: Suggested ways to start a conversation, as cards in a grid or rows in a list. Choosing one hands the starter to the app.
whenToUse: In the empty state of a new conversation, with four to six starters.
whenNotToUse: Not for follow-up questions after a reply, which is AiFollowUpSuggestions. Not for saved prompts a person manages, which is AiPromptTemplatePicker.
api: init(_ prompts: [MonarchAiStarterPrompt], layout: MonarchAiStarterPromptsLayout = .grid, hidesPrompt: Bool = false, label: String? = nil, onSelect: @escaping @MainActor (MonarchAiStarterPrompt) -> Void)
MonarchAiStarterPrompt.init(id: String, title: String, prompt: String, systemImage: String? = nil)

options.name: prompts
options.description: The starters, most useful first. Each has an id, a title, the prompt and an optional SF Symbol.

options.name: layout
options.description: grid shows cards in as many columns as fit; list shows full-width rows.

options.name: hidesPrompt
options.description: Hides the prompt text under each title.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken name "Suggested prompts".

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Runs with the starter that was chosen.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The starter takes the subtle AI fill and the AI border.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With disabled(true) the title, icon and prompt use the disabled text role and the border the subtle border role.

states.name: empty
states.description: With no starters nothing is shown.

appearance: Each starter is a surface-coloured card with the default border and the card's corner radius; the title is default text, the icon the strong AI role and the prompt muted text. Pressing tints it with the AI roles. All roles come from the theme.
platformNotes: The web tints a card on hover; touch has no hover, so the tint is the pressed state. onSelect receives the starter (the web passes the prompt text and the starter). The icon is an SF Symbol name, not arbitrary content. The cards in one row are not stretched to the same height. At the accessibility text sizes the grid becomes one column, because two columns cannot fit a phone.
accessibility: The starters are a group named "Suggested prompts".
Each starter is a button named by its title, with the prompt as its hint. With hidesPrompt there is no hint.
The touch target of a starter is at least 44 points high.
The pressed tint is animated only when Reduce Motion is off.
edgeCases: The prompt is cut after two lines; VoiceOver still reads all of it. The title wraps.
One starter fills a single column.
